<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal" dir="ltr"><strong>Problem 1: the fill-up wait is what eats the buffer time</strong></p>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal" dir="ltr">Right now a driver can't leave until the vehicle is full, but "full" depends on strangers showing up at a stage in real time — so the departure time is unpredictable, and that unpredictability is exactly what eats into the check-in/ticketing/security buffer passengers need. <ul dir="ltr" class="[li_&]:mb-0 [li_&]:mt-1 [li_&]:gap-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1">
<li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Each cab (4/7/11/14-seater) posts a trip tied to a specific train — say the 6:00pm departure — with a <strong>computed latest-leave time</strong>, worked backward from the train time minus security screening, ticket printing, and check-in buffer, minus travel time from the pickup route to the terminus.</li>
<li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Passengers reserve a seat against that trip in advance. The seat count fills virtually — the driver can see "3 of 7 booked" hours before anyone is physically at the stage.</li>
<li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Once a cab hits a minimum threshold (or a cutoff time), it's confirmed and locked — driver commits to leaving at the calculated time, passengers get a notification telling them when to be at the pickup point.</li>
<li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">If a cab isn't filling fast enough as the cutoff nears, the app can drop the fare slightly or open it up more visibly to fill the last seats — same instinct a driver has now, just faster and visible to everyone at once instead of one stage at a time.</li>
</ul>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal" dir="ltr">This turns "wait until full" into "book until full," which is the actual unlock — drivers stop gambling on how long to wait, and passengers stop gambling on whether they'll make security in time.</p>

<li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Arriving passengers state a destination or route zone (Jomvu, Miritini, Nyali, CBD, etc.) either while still on the train or right after alighting.</li>
